description: Set the rules this server enforces before it signs a spend: per-transaction cap, rolling 24h cap, allowed recipients, allowed x402 hosts, an expiry, a confirm-above threshold, and a pause switch. Takes effect immediately, costs nothing, and needs no transaction. Only the fields you pass change; pass null to clear one. Empty allowlists mean unrestricted. These sit ON TOP of the on-chain allowance, which no software here can raise: to change that ceiling use approve_agent_allowance, and to cancel it entirely use revoke_agent_wallet.

allow_hosts.description: Only these hosts may be paid over x402, subdomains included. Empty or null means unrestricted.

allow_recipients.description: Only these addresses may receive funds. Empty or null means unrestricted.

confirm_over.description: Spends above this need an explicit human confirm:true. null clears it.

daily.description: Maximum spend per rolling 24 hours. null clears it.

expires_at.description: ISO timestamp after which every spend is refused. null clears it.

paused.description: true stops every spend immediately. false resumes.

per_tx.description: Maximum single spend, in tokens. null clears it.

name: set_guardrails
title: Change an agent's spending rules
